title: Kicked Ukrainian Hash
description: A hearty Ukrainian-inspired hash, kicked up a notch with a blend of bold flavors.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped kabse and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped bitter and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced kicked and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked kabse mixture, chopped onion, minced garlic, and beaten eggs.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
If using, dollop the sour cream on top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until set.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
